text.name: gn_tool_home_desc
text.text: Everything for this neighbour in one tool. Shift+Q changes the place size: home (where he stands and his photo on the map), vehicle (tractor), vehicle + attachment (long place for an implement), oversize (combine), silo (free seeds and fertilizer). Turn it to set the direction. The panel in the bottom right shows set / needed.

text.name: gn_tool_parking_desc
text.text: First parking slot of the neighbour's machines; the others follow in a row to the right. The direction you turn it is where the machines face.

text.name: gn_plan_field_today
text.text: Drives out to the fields today at about %s

text.name: gn_settings_calls_info
text.text: How often per in-game day the neighbours may call each farm with contracts. Only the server admin can change it.

text.name: gn_settings_fields_info
text.text: How many fields a neighbour offers in one call.

text.name: gn_settings_work_info
text.text: Neighbours work their fields themselves with their own machines.

text.name: gn_nav_field
text.text: %s hitched - now the fields (green circles on the map).

text.name: gn_nav_return
text.text: Field work done - bring the %s back to %s and unhitch it at the green circle. Only then the contract counts.

text.name: gn_notify_borrow_thanks
text.text: %s got the machine back - thanks! (+20 relationship points)

text.name: gn_notify_borrow_late
text.text: %s had to fetch his machine himself (-40 relationship points).

text.name: gn_offer_supplies
text.text: Seeds, fertilizer or spray you can fill for free at my yard.

text.name: gn_tool_slot_desc
text.text: One parking place for one machine of this neighbour (tractor first, then the implements). Turn it to set where the machine faces. The list in the bottom right corner shows how many places he still needs.

text.name: gn_tool_place_desc
text.text: A place the neighbours visit during their day (see their daily plan in the phone).

text.name: gn_tool_remove_desc
text.text: Place it next to a neighbour place - the nearest one within 30 m (shown red) is removed.

text.name: gn_notify_removed
text.text: The nearest neighbour place was removed.

text.name: gn_line_henryk_1
text.text: Good morning! Henryk here. My back isn't what it used to be and the work is piling up.

text.name: gn_line_henryk_2
text.text: Henryk speaking. In my day we did all this by hand - today I would rather pay a good neighbour.

text.name: gn_line_henryk_3
text.text: It's Henryk. The weather won't wait, and I can't be everywhere at once.

text.name: gn_line_sarah_1
text.text: Hi, Sarah here! The cows keep me busy all day - could you help me out on the fields?

text.name: gn_line_sarah_2
text.text: Sarah calling. Milking, feeding, the vet... and the fields still need work.

text.name: gn_line_sarah_3
text.text: Hey, it's Sarah. I trust you with my fields more than anyone else around here.

text.name: gn_line_jonas_1
text.text: Jonas here! I just got a new machine, but I can't run it on three fields at once.

text.name: gn_line_jonas_2
text.text: Hey, Jonas speaking. GPS says I'm behind schedule - fancy some work?

text.name: gn_line_jonas_3
text.text: It's Jonas. Dad says I took on too much land. Help me prove him wrong?

text.name: gn_line_teresa_1
text.text: Good day, Teresa here. The vegetables need me, so I am looking for help with the fields.

text.name: gn_line_teresa_2
text.text: Teresa speaking. I pay fair and on time, you know that.

text.name: gn_line_teresa_3
text.text: It's Teresa. A neighbour in need is a neighbour indeed - and I need one today.

text.name: gn_talk_fallback_3

text.name: gn_help_overview_1
text.text: Seven neighbours live on the map: four farmers who farm the NPC fields, the mayor, the grain trader and the machinery dealer. Each has a day plan: he works, eats, runs errands, visits places and sometimes your farm yard. His photo on the map shows where he is right now.

text.name: gn_help_overview_2
text.text: The better you know a neighbour, the more he pays and the more he trusts you. Every farm has its own relationship with every neighbour.

text.name: gn_help_phone_1
text.text: Shift+N opens the phone: messages, contacts with the day plan of every neighbour, and the settings. In the morning a farmer sends a text and then calls with work on his fields - answer with the green receiver.

text.name: gn_help_phone_2
text.text: The admin decides how many calls a day every farm gets and how many fields one call offers (ESC - Settings).

text.name: gn_help_talk_1
text.text: Walk up to a neighbour and press Shift+N to talk. What he talks about depends on where he is and what he is doing, on the season and on how well you know each other.

text.name: gn_help_talk_2
text.text: Your answers count: kind and helpful ones bring relationship points, rude ones cost points. The first talk with each neighbour per day counts.

text.name: gn_help_contracts_1
text.text: The contracts on the neighbours fields are normal game contracts, mixed with the others. A neighbour pays a contractor rate per hectare, never less than the game pays.

text.name: gn_help_contracts_2
text.text: Every relationship level adds a bonus to his pay (up to 30 percent) and pays back part of the machine lease (up to 50 percent).

text.name: gn_help_lend_1
text.text: Answer a call with the middle button to work with the neighbours own machine. A blinking green circle on the map shows where to go now, a red one the next stage: pick it up, work the fields, bring it back.

text.name: gn_help_lend_2
text.text: Unhitch it at its place in his yard and he thanks you. Bring it back late (after 8:00 the next day) and he is disappointed. Seeds and fertilizer for his contracts are free at his yard and silo.

text.name: gn_help_work_1
text.text: Contracts nobody takes are done by the neighbours themselves with their own tractor, implements and combine. Every day they drive out at another time.

text.name: gn_help_work_2
text.text: Their car and tractor also go along their day plan: to the filling station, the workshop, the grain trade, the shop or your yard.

text.name: gn_help_tools_1
text.text: The mod sets up any map by itself: homes on the neighbours farmland next to buildings, places for every machine around the home (off the fields), and the places they visit, found from the buildings of the map.

text.name: gn_help_tools_2
text.text: The admin corrects them in the construction menu, category Good Neighbours: Shift+Q changes the place size, Shift+Del removes all of a kind, Shift+G sets missing places again. The panel in the bottom right shows set / needed.

text.name: gn_help_settings_1
text.text: ESC - Settings, section Good Neighbours: calls per day, fields per call and whether the neighbours work themselves (admin only), plus your phone: wallpaper, ring volume, mute and messages.

text.name: gn_help_settings_2
text.text: In the phone, the admin can also dress a neighbour like himself and move his home or parking to where he stands.

text.name: gn_notify_supply_ready
text.text: %s put out %s for your contract at his silo (%d l). Load it there.

text.name: gn_notify_deadline
text.text: Deadline: %d day(s) - after that the neighbour gives the work to someone else.

text.name: gn_notify_slot_overlap
text.text: Careful: this place overlaps another one - the machines would stand in each other. Remove it and set it with more room.

text.name: gn_set_airplane_info_on
text.text: Airplane mode is on - the neighbours do not call your farm.

text.name: gn_set_airplane_info_off
text.text: Airplane mode turns off the neighbours' calls for your whole farm.

text.name: gn_notify_airplane_on
text.text: Airplane mode on: no more calls from the neighbours for your farm.

text.name: gn_notify_airplane_off
text.text: Airplane mode off: the neighbours can call again.

text.text: I see you are busy - never mind, I will take care of it myself.

text.text: I see you are busy - never mind, I will take care of it myself.

text.text: Put it where your farm yard is: the neighbours come to visit you here (one per farm).
